title: 第964章 死一个王座你爹跟你姓第963章 那倘若目标不是你们呢
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
西方天地战场之上，大军正在全力攻城。
纵无数位王座坐镇，单单一位王座加持身后修士的战力仍是恐怖的。
大乾王朝的战线，太长了，就注定了无法将更多的实力用在抵抗古界之上，维持当然可以，却是被一定程度打压着的。
这种状态，让苍王眼神中露出激动，看来削减了道韵之后的大乾王朝，并没有想象中的那么强！
如此，只要打破眼前的天地，那就是大功一件，甚至不必担忧和其他王座瓜分战果，只要能打下去......
可他却突然收到其他战线求援消息。
“西南方向天地求援！”
“有天命准帝携极道帝兵而来！”
“是魔宗宗主楚倾秋，她入场这个时代了，速来，速来！！”
光是从传音的崩溃程度，便可知晓王座之一的暗王承受着多大的威胁！
仙帝后人，准帝巅峰，无缺之身，手持极道帝兵！
苍王听到这话的时候愣了一下，还以为是在开玩笑。
然而紧随其后，又有传音。
“西方天地方向，道祖与大乾王朝两面夹击，这是瓮中捉鳖之势！”
“他手中兵器，品秩远超寻常帝兵，速来支援！”
“东南方天地文圣，该死！他竟也有极致帝兵，帝子！帝子，速来救援，否则今日便难善终！”
他们这才意识到，天命准帝的去向，他们根本没打算死守西方天地，而是把真正的目标放在了他们的身上，目标是他们啊！
一对一单挑天命准帝，最弱的文圣都是无缺之身，还手持极致帝兵，如此对抗，他们势必占据下风！
至于为何古界没有极道帝兵这种品秩的兵器，至多不过帝兵？
也不看看是谁打造的，天工能给他们打造极道帝兵么，之前是有一个，但不是被夜王裘天道给弄丢了么！

此刻，苍王觉得自己应该去支援，毕竟若是损失了王座，那等于古界缺了一个位置，这种时候找谁来填补？
可他越听越觉得不对劲，几方天地都有人截杀，那他坐镇的东方天地，是不是也应该有人.......
苍王的冷汗一瞬间就下来了，立刻脑海中浮现出九天十地的布局，一方天地各自派遣一位天命准帝，九天十地来了是五个人吧！！
西方天地，数位王座，恐怕应该有最强之人坐镇，可派去道祖、文圣、楚倾秋，就还剩两个，一个龙姝一个楚宁。
楚宁断无可能去坐镇西方的，除非他想死，那就是龙姝去，所以他背后的应该是楚宁，先他娘别的不考虑这帮狗东西是怎么插入到他们的背后的，只谈一件事情，如果是楚宁，他一定能有生路，就算楚宁有帝兵加持，那也.......
他感受到一阵寒意在身后，而身旁的众修士也都是瞳孔放大下意识地倒退，紧接着便有声音从身后传来。
不是对他说的，是对他们攻城的守将说的。
“李将军，你们的人，去解决其他人。”
“苍王交予本座来杀。”
一听声音不对，楚宁什么时候娘化了，一转身双腿都在发软，就在眼前，龙姝直入大阵后方，一个人盯死了他。
只在万分之一瞬他便做出决定，求援。
然后逃！！！
“东方天地，本王被龙姝截杀！！”
“她有极致帝兵！！”
惶恐声远超任何一个王座，他在十位王座之中垫底，但垫底的意思是，让他直面九天十地杀力最高的剑修是么！
打你妈啊！
......
当楚宁选择出现在西方天地的那一刻，其实也就注定了其他四位王座的结局。
手持极致帝兵的无缺天命准帝，去斩下位王座，完全就是上等马对抗下等马，只有碾压，但短时间之内，想要斩杀还是难事，需要有这么个人拖延时间。
那么五位天命准帝中的下等马楚宁，就得一个人拖住眼前的六人。
content_en:
On the battlefield of Western Heaven and Earth, the army is attacking the city with all its strength.
Even if there are countless thrones sitting on the throne, the combat power of the monks behind them is still terrifying with the blessing of just one throne.
The battle line of the Daqian Dynasty was too long, so it was destined to be unable to use more strength to resist the ancient world. Of course it could be maintained, but it was suppressed to a certain extent.
This state made King Cang's eyes show excitement. It seemed that the Daqian Dynasty after cutting off Dao Yun was not as strong as imagined!
In this way, as long as you break the world in front of you, it will be a great achievement. You don't even have to worry about sharing the results with other thrones, as long as you can continue to fight...
But he suddenly received news from other fronts asking for help.
"Look to the southwest for help from Heaven and Earth!"
"There is a destined quasi-emperor coming with the emperor's soldiers!"
"It's Chu Qingqiu, the leader of the Demon Sect. She has entered this era. Come quickly, come quickly!!"
Just from the collapse of the sound transmission, we can know how much threat the Dark King, one of the thrones, is facing!
The descendant of the Immortal Emperor, the pinnacle of the Quasi-Emperor, with a flawless body, holding the ultimate emperor weapon!
King Cang was stunned for a moment when he heard this, thinking it was a joke.
But immediately after, there was another message.
"In the direction of the western world, Daozu and the Daqian Dynasty are attacking from both sides. This is a situation of catching a turtle in an urn!"
"The quality of the weapons in his hands far exceed those of ordinary imperial soldiers. Come quickly to support him!"
"Damn it, the literary saint of the world in the southeast! He actually has the ultimate emperor's soldiers, the emperor's son! The emperor's son, come to the rescue quickly, otherwise today will not end well!"
Only then did they realize that they had no intention of guarding the Western world as to the whereabouts of the Destiny Quasi-Emperor. Instead, they had set their real target on them. The target was them!
In a one-on-one challenge to the Quasi-Emperor of Destiny, the weakest Literary Sage is both intact and armed with the ultimate imperial weapon. In such a confrontation, they will definitely have the upper hand!
As for why there are no weapons of this rank in the ancient world like the Jidao Imperial Weapons, they are no more than Imperial Weapons at best?
No matter who made it, could Tiangong create the ultimate emperor's weapon for them? There was one before, but wasn't it lost by the Night King Qiu Tiandao?
At this moment, King Cang felt that he should go to support him. After all, if he lost his throne, it would mean that there was a missing position in the ancient world. Who could fill it at this time?
But the more he listened, the more he felt that something was wrong. There were people intercepting and killing people in several worlds. So, should there be people in the Dongfang world where he was sitting...
King Cang's cold sweat broke out in an instant, and the layout of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths immediately appeared in his mind. Each of the Heavens and Earths sent a destiny quasi-emperor. There must be five people from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths! !
In the Western World, there are several thrones, and I am afraid that there should be the strongest person sitting there. But after sending Dao Zu, Wen Sheng, and Chu Qingqiu, there are only two left, one is Long Shu and the other is Chu Ning.
It is absolutely impossible for Chu Ning to go and take control of the west. Unless he wants to die, that is Long Shu, so the person behind him should be Chu Ning. First of all, don’t think about how these dogs got in behind their backs. I only want to talk about one thing. If it is Chu Ning, he will definitely have a way to survive. Even if Chu Ning has the blessing of the imperial soldiers, then...
He felt a chill behind him, and the monks beside him also subconsciously stepped back with their pupils dilated, and then there was a voice coming from behind.
It was not said to him, but to the defenders of their siege.
"General Lee, your men, go deal with the others."
"Prince Cang leaves it to me to kill you."
When she heard something was wrong in the voice, Chu Ning turned into a girl. When she turned around, her legs were weakening. Right in front of her, Long Shu went straight to the back of the formation and stared at him to death.
In just a ten thousandth of a second, he made the decision to call for help.
Then escape! ! !
"Dongfang Tiandi, this king was intercepted and killed by Long Shu!!"
"She has the ultimate imperial weapon!!"
The sound of panic far exceeded any throne. He was at the bottom among the ten thrones, but the bottom meant that he was allowed to face the most lethal sword cultivator in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths!
Hit your mother!
......
The moment Chu Ning chose to appear in the Western World, the fate of the other four thrones was actually destined.
The quasi-emperor with the perfect destiny holding the ultimate imperial weapon, went to kill the next throne. It was completely a matter of superior horses versus inferior horses. They could only crush him, but in a short period of time, it was still difficult to kill him. He needed such a person to delay the time.
Then Ma Chuning, the inferior among the five destined quasi-emperors, would have to hold off the six people in front of him by himself.
